question: Which Python operations consume the serial fixed-work search, and is there evidence for one narrow optimization?
scope: Three fixed initial decisions. This is a diagnostic profile, not another process scaling, complete game, or playing strength study.
root_adjustment: Set player.pips to 7 after ordinary scenario construction. Preserve every other field.
order: For each listed scenario run an unprofiled control, then a cProfile instrumented search. Construct a fresh engine with the same seed and allowances for every execution. No unrecorded search warmup.
measurement: Time only MCTS.search with perf_counter. Root and engine construction, serialization, profile conversion and file writes remain outside. cProfile perturbs execution and its time is never compared as an optimization speedup. Retain function call counts, self time and cumulative time. Cumulative times overlap and must not be summed as elapsed time.
identity: Require identical actual simulations, transitions, unused transitions, stop reasons, raw root action visits/value sums, ranked actions, final random generator state and unchanged root bytes between control and instrumented execution. Reject safety-cap shortfalls without replacing them.
resource_policy: One serial search process. Collect only after the implementation coordinator grants an exclusive agent measurement slot. Preserve ordinary user applications and settings, record shared machine conditions, and make no claim of exclusive machine access.
failure_policy: Require clean committed source. Exclusively create a new attempt. Checkpoint before and after each execution. Retain failures, interruptions, incomplete work and mismatches. Stop on the first such outcome without retry. Record source hashes again at the end.
source_identity: Record full revision and normalized hashes of this protocol, runner, reused atomic writer, engine, game and data. Raw profiler filenames are reduced to repository paths, Python library paths or external basenames before export.
decision_rule: Inspect the profile before selecting any change. One localized optimization may proceed only if it addresses measured cost without changing action legality, random draws, floating-point order, work budgets or resource ownership. Declare and commit a separate paired timing protocol before measuring its benefit. Otherwise record a no-change decision with the observed cost and reason. This diagnostic alone cannot justify a native rewrite or broad speedup claim.
reproduction: python tools/run_serial_profile.py --output serial-profile.json --conditions "Describe actual shared machine conditions"
